settings.problem_copy: Brown Cows needed a premium digital home for farm stays, learning retreats, and A2 dairy products, warm rural branding with clear paths to book, explore, and trust the farm experience.
settings.success_items:
Hero-led FarmStay homepage that sells “rural luxury”
Clear CTAs for stays, farm visits, and products
Google reviews surfaced as social proof on-site
Brand footer with contact, policies, and WhatsApp path
settings.work_heading: Shopify/web system for FarmStay + dairy brand
settings.work_subcopy: Website and brand UX modules for experiential and product brands, booking-ready pages, reviews, and conversion paths under one partner.

settings.title: Shopify / web UX

settings.title: Brand visual system
settings.copy: Earthy palette, farm photography framing, and consistent logo/lockup across hero and footer.

settings.title: Google reviews UI
settings.copy: On-site testimonial grid with star ratings and a clear path to “See all reviews on Google.”

settings.title: Conversion CTA
settings.copy: Adventure banner (“Ready for Your Farm Adventure?”) driving exploration and bookings.
